coverLetter:
Dear Hiring Team,
I am applying for the IT Cloud Web Application Platform Engineer position. My background includes software development, systems integration, production workload migration, and technical support. As a Manager at DSTax Technologies, I serve as a technical lead and lead developer for a tax-integration platform, connecting development work with implementation and ongoing support. That combination provides a relevant foundation for the Cloud Platform team's collaboration with developers to deploy and maintain cloud-based applications and services.

At DSTax Technologies, I migrated production workloads from DigitalOcean to AWS. My platform development work also included leading the transition from Version 1 to Version 2 and optimizing asynchronous operations to improve performance and throughput. These responsibilities connect directly with the role's focus on supporting applications in the cloud and working across development and operational needs. Additionally I worked on supporting end-to-end integration implementations, from requirements gathering and setup through troubleshooting and go-live support. I managed internal development projects and client-coordinated work, communicated integration updates and project status, and responded to questions and requests. I also created and maintained integration guides and knowledge-base articles to support clients using the platform as well as Developers maintaining the platform. This work required translating operational needs into technical solutions and explaining implementation details to the people relying on them.

I hope to bring my experience to WEC's IT Cloud Web Application Platform Engineer role. The combination of application hosting, operational support, and collaboration with development teams offers an opportunity to use the knowledge I've gained over the years and work in a more collaborative environment. Thank you for considering my application. I would appreciate the opportunity to discuss how my development, and implementation experience could contribute to your team.

Sincerely,
Kyle M. Anderson
reviewNotes: Emphasized AWS migration, platform upgrades, performance optimization, implementation support, and documentation. The master does not establish two years of infrastructure or AWS development experience, enterprise application scale, IaC/Terraform, Azure, FinOps, CNAPP, ALB/WAF, formal incident response, or rotating on-call experience. U.S. work authorization and sponsorship eligibility are unspecified.
